name: branchwork
description: Inspect local Git repositories and use optional configured AI through Branchwork MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Local Git tools and optional AI
interface.longDescription: Local repository status, history, diffs, blame, and optional AI assistance. Repository writes are disabled unless explicitly enabled in the local MCP configuration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect my selected local repository with Branchwork and explain its changes.
